preamble: Art for a sci-fi idle game about an AI running helium-3 mining on the Moon. Near-future, clean and plausible lunar engineering: white and light grey hulls with orange safety trim, warm grey lunar regolith. No people, no text, letters, numbers, logos or UI anywhere.
painterly: Style: painterly lunar concept art for a game, matching a set of painted building thumbnails. Hard, harsh lunar sunlight with no atmosphere: crisp light, deep black-brown shadows, painted surfaces with visible brush strokes, large readable masses of light and shadow. A hand-painted illustration, never a photograph, never a photoreal 3D render, never a clean vector or cel-shaded sprite, never pixel art.
sun: A single hard white sun from the left of the image, so surfaces facing left are brightly lit, surfaces facing right are in deep shade, and shadows fall toward the right.
icon_framing: This is a tiny UI icon for a navigation button, shown at 32 pixels: exactly one object, a bold simple silhouette that reads at a glance at that size, filling about 85% of the square, centered, nothing cut off. Loose confident brushwork, no outlines, no fine detail that would turn to noise when small. Fully transparent background (alpha) around the object: no sky, no backdrop, no ground except, where it helps, a tiny patch of grey regolith directly under it.
icon_closing: One object only, nothing else in the picture.

icons.buildings: a small white lunar habitat module with orange trim: a squat cylinder with a low dome on top and one warm lit window, a short antenna.
icons.commands: a chunky white control console with orange trim, its screen glowing warm amber, a big round orange push button on its sloped front.
icons.launch_pads: a slim white cargo rocket with orange trim lifting off a small round pad, a short bright yellow-white engine flame beneath it.
icons.research: a round-bottomed glass laboratory flask, half full of glowing amber liquid, a white stopper, a soft amber glow.
icons.projects: a white and orange lunar construction crane, its arm lifting a big curved white hull segment.
icons.ideologies: a planted flag Apollo style: a white pole with a horizontal top bar holding a blank crimson-red banner straight out (no wind on the Moon), on a tiny regolith mound.
icons.adversaries: a menacing rival mining drone: a dark gunmetal hull with angular armor plates and a single glowing red eye-light, hovering.
icons.stats: a white tablet display with orange trim showing a glowing cyan bar chart of four rising bars.
icons.story: an open hardbound book with a dark blue cover, its pages glowing softly warm amber, a ribbon bookmark.
icons.retirement: a white folding deck chair with orange trim on a tiny patch of regolith, a small blue Earth hanging low beside it.
icons.options: a chunky white mechanical gear with an orange hub, a short white wrench crossed over it.

horizon_framing: A wide panoramic strip, much wider than tall (the picture will be cropped to a band about three times as wide as it is tall, so keep everything important in the middle third of the height), seen from a low vantage across the ground toward the horizon. The base is seen from a distance, small in the frame: it spans only about a third of the picture's width, in the middle, with plenty of open regolith to its left and right (room to add more buildings later) and a band of foreground ground below it. The palette is warm grey regolith with an amber accent (warm lit windows and a lamp).

horizons.cutout: A low rolling regolith ridge with two small craters, and on it a small lunar base: a large and a small white dome habitat with orange trim, a slim mast topped by a glowing amber lamp, warm amber windows. Fully transparent background (alpha) above the ground line: no sky, no stars, no Earth, the top edge of the ground an irregular painted horizon.
horizons.earthrise: A small lunar base on a regolith plain: a large and a small white dome habitat with orange trim, a slim mast topped by a glowing amber lamp, warm amber windows. Above the horizon a black sky with a few stars and a small blue and white Earth rising low at the right. The whole frame painted, edge to edge.
horizons.earthlight: Deep lunar night, no sun at all (ignore the sun above): the ground lit only by faint cool blue earthlight from above, dim blue-grey everywhere except a small lunar base on a regolith plain, a large and a small white dome habitat with orange trim, every window glowing warm amber, a slim mast with an amber lamp casting a warm pool of light on the grey regolith, cool blue-grey shadows elsewhere. Fully transparent background (alpha) above the ground line: no sky, no stars, no Earth.

progress.pad: Repaint this exact scene, same view, same ground, same base and same painting style, and add to it: a round flat landing pad with orange edge markings a little to the left of the base, and two small white regolith extractor machines with orange trim digging into the ground at the left. Keep the background exactly as it is (transparent stays transparent, sky stays sky).
progress.liftoff: Repaint this exact scene, same view, same ground, same base, pad and extractors and same painting style, and add to it: a slim white cargo rocket with orange trim lifting off from the landing pad, a short bright yellow-white engine flame and a low spray of kicked-up regolith dust below it (no smoke clouds: the Moon has no air). Keep the background exactly as it is (transparent stays transparent, sky stays sky).
